title: Canoeing in Arusha National Park
excerpt: Paddling on Small Momella Lake in Arusha National Park, with giraffes and buffaloes on the shore. A quiet safari on the water.
body:
In Arusha National Park you can explore part of the park by canoe, on Small Momella Lake.

## What you see

Water birds such as pelicans, cormorants and sometimes flamingos. Giraffes, buffaloes and waterbuck along the shore. On clear days, Mount Meru and Kilimanjaro in the background.

## How it works

Guided trips of about two hours, in stable canoes. No experience is needed. A safety briefing and life jackets are included.

## Hippos

The lake is sometimes visited by hippos. Guides keep a safe distance.

## When

Usually in the morning or afternoon, depending on the wind and the operator.

## Combine

With a walking safari or game drive in [Arusha National Park](/blog/arusha-national-park-guide/).

Availability can vary, so check with us. [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
